02    /    THE WATER
Water holds the sky.
Tahoe, Walker and Mono lakes from orbit / NASA, ISS064-E-9397
Stillness has its own movement.
The lake is never quite the same color twice. A passing cloud
changes everything. We stayed on the shore until the reflected
mountains and the real ones seemed equally close.
